description: M/ of Energy - Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act, No. 28 of 1961 Order Under Section 40 (1)
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily deals with land acquisition by the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation. The core content is the approval of acquiring a specific property described in detail in the schedule, including its boundaries, location, and extent. While it mentions a government minister (Eng. Kumara Jayakody), the focus is squarely on the land transaction rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette under Type 4.
